title: Bee Fast
description:
Sooo Fassttt It Has To Be Bee Fast 
(Based On Fabulously Optimized)
body:
Bee Fast!!!!

This pack is made for people that genuinely hate lag in general, but want good visuals and still want a buttery smooth experience. It is a curated stack of 105 mods hand picked to kick technical glitches into the sun and let you focus on the important stuff! :D 

Disclaimer: This modpack is based on [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized/versions). All credit goes to the original modders for doing the heavy lifting. (thank you FO team, i <3 yall)

Icon Credit: Original artwork by SuperRonja123 (Pixilart). If you are the artist and want this removed, ping me on Discord.

Extra Credit: [Better Block Entities (BBE)](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-block-entities) Team for this AMAZING mod that is like SO GOOD
